protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. Basic Authentication compared the supplied username first and returned UNAUTHORIZED on mismatch; only a matching username reached bcrypt_verify, so the two username classes followed observably different work paths and enabled username enumeration.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed abc76a8c1f19e7efe2172f8808c171cb9d2e69ad. It added src/basic_auth.rs and bcrypt, with bcrypt_verify nested under the username-equality branch. The later e9d33ca38d1e1f04858bdafe9ba0ac2d2fe2f69e only rewrote the same mechanism as an early return.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. abc76a8c1f19e7efe2172f8808c171cb9d2e69ad has the single parent 5528bcb9ad2d611e8517b85762722880a90ad613, where src/basic_auth.rs does not exist and the Basic Authentication mechanism is absent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed for BIC selection. Public PR #55 is represented by feature commit abc76a8c1f19e7efe2172f8808c171cb9d2e69ad followed by docs-only f89c5c9158dad55d5a0507f17d5ada548865f36c, then merge a3f4258e9a8b0a2b19bbf50786aab29ae9813c7b; the merge and docs commit are not introducers. The direct fix 7bf0fd425eb10dac9bf9ef5febce12c4dd039ce1 is a single-parent squash-style security landing, but the exact corrective diff is present in that surviving object and does not affect BIC identity.
protocol_checks.release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is not an ancestor of v2.0.3 and is an ancestor of v2.1.0, whose src/basic_auth.rs contains the username-gated bcrypt call. Fix 7bf0fd425eb10dac9bf9ef5febce12c4dd039ce1 is not an ancestor of v2.40.1 and is an ancestor of v2.41.0; the v2.41.0 changelog names the timing-based username-enumeration fix. This matches the published CVE range >=2.1.0,<2.41.0.
protocol_checks.direct_fix: Confirmed 7bf0fd425eb10dac9bf9ef5febce12c4dd039ce1. Its parent 08900b36648123eac19fb3203331d8903cd41174 still returns before bcrypt on username mismatch; the fix computes user_match, always performs bcrypt_verify, and combines both results before returning.
protocol_checks.advisory_disposition: Confirmed real and published, not a withdrawn or rejected advisory. CVE.org reports CVE-2026-27480 state=PUBLISHED and cites GHSA-qhp6-635j-x7r2 plus fix 7bf0fd425eb10dac9bf9ef5febce12c4dd039ce1; the frozen GHSA record has withdrawn_at=null.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed absent on the BIC only. Commit abc76a8c1f19e7efe2172f8808c171cb9d2e69ad names Jose Quintana as author and committer, has message 'feat: basic http authentication support' / 'resolves #53', and has no trailers or AI/bot-generation marker. Fix-commit authorship and wording were not used for attribution.

findings: The primary record identifies the correct vulnerability mechanism, atomic introducer, immediate parent, affected range, direct fix, and fixed release.

Independent local Git replay confirms abc76a8c1f19e7efe2172f8808c171cb9d2e69ad is the first public write of the vulnerable username-gated bcrypt path; e9d33ca38d1e1f04858bdafe9ba0ac2d2fe2f69e preserves rather than introduces it.
The evidence supports NOT_AI because attribution is restricted to the BIC and that object contains no AI marker.
